create.title: Literal coefficientwise dictionary for balanced smooth M2 residual blocks
create.statement_tex: Let X>=4096 be real, R=sqrt X, y=floor R, D_j=2^(-j)y, H=floor(D_j X^(-1/4)), and L_r=2^(-r)H. The fixed eta/W telescopes give exact denominator and frequency partitions; only j=0 and r=0 are clipped, and H=1,2 have no full smooth residual frequency label. For every residual full-smooth block B=(X,j,r,+), define the whole d=0 summand as zero, set K=XL/D^2 and M=LK, and define the real continuum amplitude A_B(x,z)=W(x/L)Phi(x/(H+1))(M/(xz))^(3/4)W(sqrt(xX/(4zD^2))) on the positive quadrant, extended by zero. Then B_(2,B)=8 Re B_B^+, B_B^+=-c_B T_B+E_(B,tr), c_B=e(1/8)X^(1/4)M^(-3/4)/(2pi), |E_(B,tr)|<<1, and all rescaled symbol seminorms are uniform. Moreover K/L=4^j X/floor(sqrt X)^2: j=1 is balanced, j=2 is balanced exactly for square X at K/L=16, and j>=3 is unbalanced. With G_0=sqrt L/2, the explicit smooth gcd telescope has low weight eta(g/G_0), exact integer bottom c_LW(g), and high owner 1-eta(g/G_0). Writing h=gu,k=gv gives T_B^low=(1/(2i))sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R), where Q is the chi_4(u)-weighted 1/4 packet minus the 3/4 packet and Q(-R)=-conj Q(R). High gcd is owned first; exact squares and nonsquare R^(-1)-near-squares are explicit disjoint signed low-part corrections. Thus T_B=T_B^hi+S_B^sq+S_B^near+T_B^res and B_(2,B)=8 Re[-c_B(T_B^hi+S_B^sq+S_B^near+T_B^res)+E_(B,tr)] coefficientwise. The first open analytic assertion is |sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R)|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon for each fixed B. The dictionary is capacity-preserving and proves no signed estimate or exponent.
create.next_action: Attack the literal per-block signed quarter-packet sum with its complete actual symbol. Preserve both quarter shifts, chi_4, the full internal gcd-shell sum, and the fixed-block outer modulus.

update.statement_tex: Fix one real smooth positive-frequency residual physical block B=(X,D,L,+) with R=sqrt X, K=XL/D^2 and 1<=K/L<=16. The exact full-small-gcd transform is T_(B,small)^(+,full)=(1/(2i))sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R), where Q retains chi_4(u) and is the 1/4 packet minus the 3/4 packet. For real profiles Q(-R)=-conj(Q(R)), giving physical frequency conjugacy after the factor 1/(2i). The packet represents the full small-gcd shell; exact squares and R^(-1)-near-squares are explicit signed corrections, never arithmetic masks inside the smooth profile. The absolute value remains outside the complete internal gcd-shell sum for each fixed physical block, and distinct D or L blocks cannot cancel before the accepted blockwise assembly. Shellwise l1, product-fibre absolute values, and Gram norms are stronger. The current envelope loses min(L^(1/2),R^(1/2)/L), maximally X^(1/12) at L=X^(1/6). The coefficientwise continuum bridge, clipped-profile dictionary, exact gcd bottom, crossing owner, and physical correction equation are now instantiated by M9-M2-balanced-smooth-literal-atom-dictionary; no analytic packet estimate is included.
update.next_action: Use the proved literal dictionary and its exact physical one-count equation. The next gap is the signed per-block L^(3/2) quarter-packet estimate, not another normalization or owner-reconciliation step.

Retain this as the abstract full-small-gcd reduction. Its literal balanced M2 instantiation is now M9-M2-balanced-smooth-literal-atom-dictionary; the remaining work is analytic cancellation in the complete signed packet.

Prove |sum_sigma G_sigma Q_(B,sigma)^full(R)|<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon for the literal Round-113 block. The persistent balanced denominator is j=1, with only an isolated exact-square j=2 boundary. Do not use cross-block cancellation, arithmetic masks in the smooth profile, shellwise l1, unsigned spacing, or arbitrary coefficients.

Retain the proved blockwise owner architecture. The balanced child now has a literal coefficientwise dictionary and physical correction equation, but its signed estimate remains open; the hard and unbalanced parents are independent and also open.

reject.reason: Integer coefficient values do not determine the continuum profile required by Poisson. The positive-quadrant smooth extension and its seminorms must be explicitly fixed.
W(0)=0 does not make e(hX/(4d)) meaningful at d=0. The entire d=0 summand must be defined as zero or omitted.
The low packet alone omits the high-gcd owner and transform error. The full physical equation must display high, square, near, residual, and error terms.
An optional blockwise owner convention is incompatible with coefficientwise one-count. Priority and equality ownership must be frozen globally for the dictionary.
The exact identity K/L=4^jX/floor(sqrt X)^2 puts j=2 in the balanced range only when X is an exact square and K/L=16.
Exact-square and near-square complements are arithmetic and nonsmooth. They are explicit signed corrections to the full smooth packet.
The accepted physical assembly is blockwise. The packet modulus is per fixed D,L block and cannot combine distinct physical blocks.
The dictionary is an exact representation. X^(1/12) is the worst remaining analytic deficit, not a saving.

no_change.reason: The literal antecedent is now proved, but the signed L^(3/2) packet estimate is not.
Round 113 concerns only smooth balanced blocks.
The unbalanced product-phase parent is independent.
Its hard, balanced, and unbalanced analytic parents remain open.
Uniform completion of all physical packets remains open.
Neither M9-M1 nor M9-M2 is closed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 113 closes the literal continuum-symbol, d=0, gcd-bottom, owner-priority, and physical one-count seams for the balanced smooth M2 child. It reduces the persistent denominator geometry to j=1 plus an isolated exact-square j=2 boundary, but proves no analytic cancellation, range, or exponent.
